title: vault-themes — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins the MYT5 vault.themes envelope — the v0.2 side of the §10.4.1 md.6 protocol_version split (myne-md/myne#441), and the KEK-envelope archetype every single-KEK blob family shares byte-for-byte. Two case kinds: 'encrypt' (encoder byte output under the v0.2 envelope) and 'decode_fail_v0_1' (a v0.1 decoder must not open it). ONE DETAIL HERE READS LIKE A BUG AND IS NOT: the header's themes_format_version byte stays 0x01 even though the family is v0.2. That byte is the FORMAT version of the inner payload, not the protocol major, and it is not AEAD-bound — the domain separation is carried entirely by the magic (MYT5 vs MYT1), the AAD prefix ('myne.v0.2|' via aad_singleton_blob_v0_2) and the KEK's HKDF context prefix ('myne.v0.2 '). A port that 'fixes' this byte to 0x02 produces a blob the reference decoder rejects. Reference implementation: protocol/src/themes_blob.rs (decode_themes_blob_versioned) in the main myne repository.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'vault-themes/v0.2/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

oneOf.title: encrypt — pin the v0.2 envelope's byte output

input_custom_themes_key_hex.description: 32-byte KEK (hex), supplied DIRECTLY rather than derived from a root_key. The v0.2 subkey derivation uses the 'myne.v0.2 ' HKDF context prefix, which is pinned as its own concern; handing the KEK in keeps this case about the envelope.

input_account_number_hash_hex.description: 16-byte account_number_hash (hex), AAD-bound via aad_singleton_blob_v0_2(b"custom-themes-blob", hash) — the generic v0.2 singleton builder, since v0.2 has no per-family AAD functions.

input_plaintext_hex.description: Opaque inner plaintext (hex) — the client layer's serialized {theme_name -> palette} map. Empty allowed (the empty theme store).

input_nonce_hex.description: 24-byte XChaCha20-Poly1305 nonce (hex). Fixed here so the bytes are reproducible (the raw encoder); production callers pull from a CSPRNG.

expected_magic_ascii.description: The v0.2 themes magic, spelled in ASCII beside the hex so a reviewer can read it without decoding. MYT5 is the reserved next-major counterpart of MYT1 in the §10.3 allocation table.

expected_version_byte_hex.description: The themes_format_version byte — 0x01, NOT 0x02. It versions the inner payload format, not the protocol major, and it is not AEAD-bound; magic + AAD prefix + KEK context carry the domain separation on their own. Pinned as a const here precisely because it looks like an inconsistency and would otherwise get 'corrected'.

expected_blob_hex.description: Full encoder output (header + ciphertext + 32-byte CTX tag), hex-encoded lowercase. Opens with 4d595435 ('MYT5') then 01.

oneOf.title: decode_fail_v0_1 — a v0.1 decoder must not open a v0.2 envelope

input_blob_hex.description: The MYT5 blob offered to a decoder expecting the v0.1 envelope. The mixed-fleet direction: an un-migrated client meeting a migrated vault's theme store.

expected_error.description: Which refusal the decoder surfaces. 'cannot_decrypt' is the expected outcome when the caller asks for a v0.1 read of bytes whose AAD was built under the v0.2 prefix — the AEAD simply does not verify, and per §6.4 that failure stays non-distinguishing. 'magic_mismatch' is admissible for an implementation that checks the magic before attempting the AEAD. Both are correct refusals; what a port may NOT do is return a plaintext.
